systems_considered.name: limb_evidence_montage
systems_considered.reason: Could become too object-first and make the joke feel like body-part labels instead of a lived couple story.

systems_considered.name: single_room_sofa_escalation
systems_considered.reason: Too narrow for an all-day home pattern; it collapses the user's correction back into one incident.

systems_considered.name: domestic_collision_sequence
systems_considered.reason: Shows the all-day pattern across normal home spaces while preserving gentle, affectionate accident energy.

room_notes.visual_format_anthropologist: Use a soft seven-panel domestic ritual, not slapstick injury.
room_notes.scene_evidence_director: Every slide must show a different tiny collision receipt: elbow, shoulder, foot, sudden turn, apology, close-range anger.
room_notes.romance_blocking_director: Keep Aachu close even while annoyed. Keep Zuv guilty and checking on her.
room_notes.typography_and_aspect_director: Use upper-middle negative space for exact handwritten text. Keep figures lower or middle-lower.
room_notes.generation_prompt_director: Use the locked master prompt, identity bundle, and observational-intimacy style references.
room_notes.harsh_visual_selector: GO only if no slide reads as violence, pain, or mean comedy.
